author: Andyfx
text:
Hi Kruger! If there wasn't that little Engulf (I circled it in red on your chart) and FTR, would you have done the same trade (as RS test)? Or short at that bigger FTR above it? How do you know that that tiny FTR will hold price?

And in both situations, where do you look to place your stop loss?

author: Kruger
text:
Hi Andyfx, RS test trade would be the same as blind short of whole D1 RBD so no, I wouldn't, except with juicy PA like strong reaction or any other known reversal. Next FTR is a good option.

I do not know any other way to determine whether FTR will hold other than PA. Girls like to say "oh, size doesn't matter...":D in trading it's true but only when we have right and important LOCATION, so even tiny FTR after D1 low engulf may be significant.

Text book SL should be located above/under FTR but as always, with PA you can minimize the loss.
